# dsh-mega-plugins
English | 中文
Six DSH plugins developed as a pnpm monorepo: a local-only personal memo suite with AI analysis and
its Settings page, and an OpenWiki preview for the Web right Sidebar.
## Packages
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-telemetry** (`packages/telemetry/dsh-telemetry`) — Generic local telemetry track

er over the storage-domain KV backend (req 7).
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-github-issue** (`packages/github-
issue/dsh-github-issue`) — GitHub issue generation and optimization service using LLM (req 8, 9, 10,

11).
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-memo** (`packages/memo/dsh-memo`) — Week-keyed personal memo service with

AI analysis, report export, and telemetry logging (req 1–6, 8).
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-client-ui-memo**
(`packages/client/ui-memo`) — Browser-side UI panel with memo entry, analysis, report download, log

analysis, and issue editor (req 1–4, 6, 8, 9, 11).
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-client-ui-memo-settings** (`
packages/client/ui-memo-settings`) — Settings page for the memo suite: edits the memo Host's AI rout
e, archived-session summary copy, and GitHub repository from DSH Web, applying each save without a r

estart.
- **@zhangj1164/dsh-openwiki-visualize** (`packages/openwiki/dsh-openwiki-visualize`) — Dete
cts the OpenWiki in the selected workspace, serves it with `openwiki visualize` on loopback, and emb
eds the official reader in a self-owned right-Sidebar tab, with openwiki/DSH environment checks and
ader in a self-owned right-Sidebar tab, with openwiki/DSH environment checks and plugin self-update.

## Install into a DSH profile
`@zhangj1164/dsh-telemetry`, `@zhangj1164/dsh-github-issue`, `@zhangj1164/dsh-memo` and `@zhangj1164
/dsh-client-ui-memo-settings` each declare their own `dsh.bundle`, and every composition entry id ha
s exactly one owning bundle. A subset composes as cleanly as the whole suite, so name the packages y
y one owning bundle. A subset composes as cleanly as the whole suite, so name the packages you want:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Every package whose row or injected service the boot needs must be named. A profile sets `autoInstal
lPeers: false`, so an install brings in only what the command names — `@zhangj1164/dsh-memo` alone l
eaves the `github-issue` and `ui-memo` rows unresolvable and the loader fails the boot.
`@zhangj1164/dsh-client-ui-memo` declares no bundle of its own: `@zhangj1164/dsh-memo`'s patch inser
ts its `ui-memo` row, so the panel is activated by installing `@zhangj1164/dsh-memo` — but the packa
ge itself still has to be named, and `dsh plugin add` reports it as a plain dependency rather than a
profile layer. That warning is expected for a `dsh.client` plugin, not a defect. `@zhangj1164/dsh-c
lient-ui-memo-settings` differs on purpose: it carries its own bundle patch, which inserts the `ui-m
emo-settings` row, so it installs as a profile layer and can be added or removed without touching th
e memo bundle. Its page registers only while the deployed memo Host serves the `memo` settings names
pace, so installing it without the memo suite leaves no visible trace.
`@zhangj1164/dsh-telemetry` and `@zhangj1164/dsh-github-issue` expose Cordis services (`ctx.telemetr
y`, `ctx.githubIssue`) rather than model tools or panels of their own. They are infrastructure: inst
alling `@zhangj1164/dsh-telemetry` by itself gives a consumer plugin something to call and gives an
end user nothing to see. The visible surface is the memo board.
### Install from GitHub instead of the registry
The same five packages install straight from this repository, with no registry release. pnpm selects
a package inside a repository with a `path:` parameter that belongs to the **committish**, after th
e `#` — pnpm reads it as part of the ref, so an `&path:` written against the repository URL is silen
tly taken as part of the repository name and the fetch fails:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A git install fetches source, not build output, so each package's `prepare` script builds `lib/` dur
ing the install. pnpm ≥10 does not run that script until the profile authorizes it: the first `add`
fails with `ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` and prints an exact `allowBuilds` key. The key pnp
m prints names the resolved commit, so it stops matching after the next push. Write the repository-l
evel form instead — it matches any commit — into `${DSH_HOME}/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
That authorization lets the package's code run on your machine at install time, outside any agent sa
ndbox. Allow only source you trust, and pin the commit when the installed content must stop moving —
`github:zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#<sha>&path:packages/memo/dsh-memo`, with the ref and the `path:
164/dsh-mega-plugins#<sha>&path:packages/memo/dsh-memo`, with the ref and the `path:` joined by `&`.
The registry stays the better default: a published package ships prebuilt `lib/` and needs no build
authorization at all. A git install also keeps `workspace:^` in the sibling `peerDependencies`, beca
use nothing rewrites a manifest pnpm reads straight out of a checkout. pnpm prints a peer warning fo
r those ranges, and the boot is unaffected: a profile names every package the boot needs and sets `a
utoInstallPeers: false`, so the ranges have nothing left to resolve.
